notes.title: Outsider 0.4.0
notes.notes:
This is a small feature update with a substantial content update:

[list]
[*] Updated Godot to 4.4.1, which should lead to no visible change
[*] More than 100+ text fixes to improve clarity and grammar throughout the tutorial and chapters 1-4
[*] Replaced highlight for bold in cueing user choice. This is experimental and could be reverted or improved in the future
[/list]

notes.title: Outsider Demo is Now Available!
notes.notes:
The big day has arrived! You can now play the [b]Outsider game demo [/b] with ~2 hours of content. It includes a full tutorial and four chapters (out of 20+).

This demo uses the same engine as the paid game but with fewer chapters. It has been play tested by our amazing Discord members and is ready for your enjoyment! Also make sure to check our brand-new game trailer... ;-)

HAVE FUN!
